svg.title: Siddharth Kolapalli: automotive systems and applied AI
svg.desc: Hi, I’m Sid. Every article on sidkolapalli.com started as a problem I ran into on a project. An instrument cluster: a topic dial for Simulation, MBSE, ADAS, Powertrain and AI, and a speedometer reading READY.
